data.name: Rathor
data.gender_notes: Rathor is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who drives or operates a chariot, often a symbol of power and authority in Hindu mythology. The name Rathor carries the meaning “Charioteer” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Rathor usually hope their child will grow to embody charioteer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A spiritual warrior, one who uses their strength and courage to protect and uplift others.
data.etymology: Rathor belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Charioteer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rathor total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Rathor" has its origins in the Rajput community of India, who were known for their warrior tradition and the use of chariots in battle. The name carries the connotation of strength, courage, and royalty, as well as a connection to the rich history and culture of India.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hindu mythology, the chariot is a symbol of the journey of the soul toward spiritual enlightenment. The Rathor name, meaning "one who drives the chariot," can be seen as a reminder to be the driver of one's own spiritual journey, navigating the ups and downs of life with determination and steadfastness, ultimately reaching the goal of self-realization and inner peace.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Rathor has its roots in the Sanskrit word 'Ratha', meaning 'chariot'. This name symbolizes a warrior, one who is steadfast, strong, and ready to embark on the journey of life with courage and determination, just as a warrior rides a chariot into battle. It also carries the spiritual significance of being a vehicle for the divine, carrying one towards enlightenment and self-realization.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted individual named Lakshmi Rathor in Hyderabad, India attributes much of their spiritual journey to their name Rathor, which means "Charioteer". They believe their name has guided them on the path of righteousness.
